articles.title: Giant Beetle Larvae Are Quietly Eating Blueberry Roots
articles.summary: Scientists used DNA barcoding to identify the five-inch-long beetle larvae damaging blueberry roots in North Carolina: the longhorn beetle Prionus imbricornus.

articles.title: Send Your Name to Titan on NASA's Dragonfly Mission
articles.summary: NASA will carry your name to Saturn's moon Titan aboard Dragonfly, a flying robot launching in 2028 that will hop between dunes and craters searching for the chemistry of life.

articles.title: Europe's Ancient Forests Were Nothing Like We Imagined
articles.summary: Europe was not covered in dense dark forest for millions of years — it was open woodland, meadows, and grazing animals. The finding questions today's dense-forest planting programs.
